北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京的朋友，阳光明媚，体感 33℃，注意防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's sunny and feels like 33℃. Stay hydrated and sun-protected!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪很热，体感 36℃，湿度大。记得多喝水，避免中暑！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is hot and humid, feels like 36℃. Drink plenty of water to avoid heatstroke!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海高温 35℃，体感 39℃。请减少户外活动，谨防中暑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is scorching at 35℃, feels like 39℃. Limit outdoor activities and watch out for heatstroke!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度高达 91%。体感闷热，多注意通风哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy with 91% humidity. It feels muggy, ensure good ventilation.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，湿度 94%。体感闷热潮湿，出门记得带伞哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with 94% humidity. It feels muggy and damp, bring an umbrella if going out.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 35℃。注意防暑降温，多补充水分！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels like 35℃. Stay cool, prevent heatstroke, and drink water!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 34℃。注意防晒，及时补充水分。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels like 34℃. Apply sunscreen and stay hydrated.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 37℃。请注意防暑降温，避免长时间暴晒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 37℃. Stay cool, prevent heatstroke, avoid prolonged sun exposure.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 36℃。记得多喝水，避免高温中暑哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like 36℃. Remember to drink water and prevent heatstroke.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 33℃。防晒补水是关键，户外注意休息。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels like 33℃. Sunscreen and hydration are key, rest if outdoors.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 38℃ 高温，体感 40℃！请务必注意防暑，做好降温措施。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is scorching at 38℃, feels like 40℃! Be sure to prevent heatstroke and stay cool.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，气温 21℃。体感舒适，记得添衣以防昼夜温差。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with a comfortable 21℃. Remember to add layers for day-night temperature changes.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 28℃，湿度大。注意防晒，保持室内通风。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and feels like 28℃ with high humidity. Protect from sun, keep indoor ventilation.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，湿度 90%，风力 4 级。感觉湿凉，出门记得带外套哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, 90% humidity, 4-level wind. Feels damp and cool, bring a jacket when out.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 26℃，风力 4 级。注意防风保暖，湿度较大。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 26℃ with 4-level wind. Watch out for wind, stay warm, and mind high humidity.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 26℃。湿度 70%，出门记得带雨具哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like 26℃. With 70% humidity, remember to bring rain gear.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，体感 27℃，风力 4 级。海边风大，注意防晒防风哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like 27℃ with 4-level wind. It's windy by the sea, protect from sun and wind!
